findings.title: Round-1 F01 is not resolved: the placeholder check matches only literal lead-in markers, so a document with the template's comments and Example: prefixes removed but its sample text kept passes --document.
findings.evidence: docs/00-working/framework/05-schemas/check_schemas.py:100. examples/plan.boilerplate.md with every <!-- --> block and leading Example: removed, body and front-matter title still the template's sample text: check_schemas.py --document <probe> --kind plan -> PASS, exit 0. Same for the requirement kind.
findings.consequence: A copied template whose author tidied away the guidance but kept the sample content still passes the family's check.

findings.title: The front-matter title is never checked for placeholder text.
findings.evidence: requirement.schema.json title has minLength 1 only; the H1 regex in check_schemas.py:100 does not read front matter. The boilerplate fixtures keep the template's title string.
findings.consequence: A document can keep the template's title indefinitely.

findings.title: --document with a nonexistent path ends in an unhandled FileNotFoundError traceback.
findings.consequence: No FAIL line for a caller to match; the exit code is Python's default, not a designed result.

findings.title: A UTF-8 byte-order mark defeats front-matter detection.
findings.evidence: FRONT_MATTER anchors on \A---; a BOM copy of requirement.valid.md reports the required front-matter properties missing, exit 1. CRLF passes.
findings.consequence: A valid document saved with a BOM fails for a misreported reason (fails closed).
